description: King于1959年推出的旁轴相机。配备Bayonet mount, 28mm, 35mm, 50mm, 90mm and 135mm lenses available。快门速度Prontor-SVS - Bulb, 1s, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60, 1/125 and 1/300th or 1/500th.。

specs.光圈: Supports lenses from f/1.9 to f/22 in 1 stop increments
specs.自拍: Yes, around 10 seconds, use V mode switch on the lens
specs.闪光灯: PC socket on the body, flash synchronization at all speeds, X and M modes
